summary.one_liner: A Python framework, agent guide and Claude Code skill that drives Blender 5.2 over MCP to turn a scientific brief and PDB or AlphaFold structures into an evidence-tagged molecular animation film.
summary.what_it_does: The repository provides "molanim", a pure-numpy science layer for reading mmCIF files and assemblies, morphing between atom-matched states, pathway profiles, procedural membranes, ion diffusion and camera paths, plus a Blender layer that builds sphere and ball-and-stick molecules, cavity tubes, interaction markers, a depth-of-field camera rig and a separate label pass. The pipeline.py command line runs new, build, still, preview, render, deliver, doctor, motion, smoke and check steps. Motion (thermal, Brownian, normal modes, side-chain turns) is modelled at literature rates rather than from molecular dynamics simulation. Every beat is tagged experimental, simulation-derived or illustrative in the script, on screen and in a production record. An AGENTS.md guide and a /new-film skill let Claude Code run the workflow through Blender MCP, and the repo includes a channelrhodopsin case study built from PDB 9GO1 and 9GO2.
use_cases: Make a scientific molecular animation film from a written brief
Animate a protein from a PDB entry in Blender
Animate an AlphaFold model with evidence labels
Generate labelled MP4 or WebM films and posters of molecular structures
Drive Blender from Claude Code to build molecular scenes
Produce a record of which molecular motions are experimental versus illustrative
how_to_run: python pipeline.py new gfp --pdb 1EMA --title "Green fluorescent protein"
notable: Evidence tagging: every beat is labelled experimental, simulation-derived or illustrative in script, film and production record
Checks structural claims in the brief numerically against the PDB structures before animating them
Motion modelled at literature rates on one clock per film, with loops that repeat exactly
Label pass can be exported as data (timeline.label_data) to draw captions over a clean film in a web page
Agent guide (AGENTS.md) and /new-film skill for Claude Code
caveats: Requires Blender 5.2, a Cycles-capable GPU (NVIDIA OptiX recommended) and ffmpeg; previews take minutes and final renders hours
Built and tested on Windows 11 with an RTX 5060 Ti; macOS and Linux are stated to be untested
pipeline.py downloads RCSB entries only; AlphaFold models must be loaded manually from a file, and AlphaFold Server outputs are not distributed
keywords: turn a paper into an animation
